title: Phone page still renders the unmetered recital; subscription field is available
description:
b13 changed the watch dashboard's cost line only. The phone page (cloudflare/src/phone.ts) still renders one line per cost source with 'not metered' for unmetered rivers, and does not show cost.subscription, which the model now carries (bundle 2.4.0). The epic's A5 ('cost shows only when metered; a claude-sub run shows subscription window use') arguably reaches this surface too, since it reads the same model.
evidence: cloudflare/src/phone.ts:930-945 (cost section), cloudflare/src/status.ts (StatusCostSubscription type now exists)
